story.title: Ajay set to reunite with Bhushan for big-budget spy thriller
story.summary: Ajay Devgn is close to signing a big-budget spy thriller with producer Bhushan Kumar, who has developed a fresh story set in the world of Indian espionage. Meetings have reportedly taken place. Shooting is likely to begin in 2027, with a mid-2028 release. Devgn is currently enjoying the success of 'Drishyam 3'.
